params.1078: This item requires a Farming level of 25 to unlock. When unlocked, farmers who harvest patches (including dead ones) have a permanent 10% chance of receiving their seeds back. There is also a 5% chance of getting a tree seed back from a dead tree/stump. For herb seeds, the seed type returned may be random.
